job.text: Ay, ay; I'll take you, ladies. That is--the young ladies might go--but you--" eying me over with his keen sailor's glance, full of honesty and good humour, "you're pretty well on in years, ma'am." Laughing, I told him how far on, but that I was able to do a good deal yet. He laughed too. "Oh, I've taken ladies much older than you. One the other day was nearly seventy. So we'll do our best, ma'am. Come along." He offered a rugged, brown hand, as firm and steady as a mast
